scope: Global source and conversion inventory used to audit story crosswalk coverage; not a list of all individual runtime resource bindings

gameplay_data.conversion: BCSV/BYML/AAMP/BFEVFL decoded to typed/indexed JSON; keep raw IDs, descriptors, exact integer values and provenance
limitations: 91 BCSV columns lack exact descriptor
431 unique BYML hash keys unresolved
decoded graph/table is not native behavior by itself

text.conversion: MSBT to JSON retaining archive, label, text, language, tags and message-source identity
limitations: runtime label selection and substitutions are partial
message text does not prove scene or voice playback

ui.conversion: BFLYT to pane-tree JSON; BFLAN sections to summary/raw JSON; BNTX to PNG; join UIName/page factory/input/message before assigning a story beat
limitations: page bindings, focus/input/modal lifecycle, renderer parity and live capture remain partial
texture count may include duplicates

animation.source: additional RomFS AnimationSequence, AnimationInfo and BFLAN; skeletal source expected in model BFRES archives
animation.conversion: ASB to state/transition/condition/event JSON; skeletal BFRES clips can be sampled to per-bone JSON when source archive and rig are present; BFLAN is a separate UI-animation format
limitations: ASB transition semantics and actor-to-state binding are partial
no model archive means skeletal clip-to-rig matching is unavailable

model.source: catalogues/model.json only; supplied additional RomFS has no Model/ source archive
model.conversion: When raw files exist: Yaz0/SARC to BFRES; BFRES to GLB (current exporter LOD0) and material extras; embedded/external BNTX to PNG/HDR; skeletal animations to JSON; `.phive` preserved verbatim
limitations: catalog row is not a mesh or converted file
catalog paths do not resolve to supplied raw source
material/LOD fidelity is limited

audio.source: catalogues/audio.json only; supplied additional RomFS has no Sound/Resource source archive
audio.conversion: When raw files exist: BARS via AMTA entries to BWAV offsets, BWAV to PCM WAV then OGG; retain sample rate, channel count, sample count and loop points
limitations: no waveform or source timing can be confirmed from the catalog alone
song/SFX consumer-to-beat and playback timing remain OPEN

texture.source: UI BNTX and limited shader/texture content in additional RomFS; model textures are expected inside unavailable model archives
texture.conversion: BNTX decoder to PNG or HDR; preserve texture name, source container, dimensions, format and color-space notes
limitations: not every texture has been converted
story consumer and material binding remain partial

material_shader.source: two BFSHA archives and limited GLSL/BNSH content
material_shader.conversion: Keep archive/option/program metadata and raw shader bytes; join material parameters to textures and consumers before engine mapping
limitations: program/key table incomplete
slot metadata is not a complete shader implementation

effect.source: two VFXB/PTCL archives plus ELink2DB.belnk and SLink2DB.bslnk
effect.conversion: Preserve source and hashes; decode and connect effect emitters, material, timing and actor consumer where format support is proven
limitations: PTCL/XLNK semantics and story/runtime callers are partial

font.source: Font archives/FontInfo are handled by reference importers when raw source is present
font.conversion: BFTTF/BFOTF to TTF/OTF; retain BFFNT raw when bitmap layout is not decoded
limitations: per-screen font assignment and exact prologue text-render binding still require crosswalk

world_data.source: FieldPreset, item/structure tables, terrain unit models and PBC references
world_data.conversion: Keep raw grid records and ID joins; resolve unit/variant/PBC and world transform only when a native consumer verifies it
limitations: full seed-to-world loader, all transforms, story actor anchors and live placement are not connected

collision.source: native collision/terrain consumers and `.phive` expected inside model archives
collision.conversion: Preserve `.phive` byte-for-byte until parser and physics semantics are validated; record collision source and owning model/transform
limitations: raw model archive absent
solver, masks, friction and full actor-to-collider binding remain incomplete

policy: Each story beat must cite an exact source or a CAT/OPEN placeholder for each asset family. These global totals do not claim every individual catalog row is used by the main-story path.
